command_words.Analyse: examine in detail to show meaning, identify elements and the relationship between them
command_words.Calculate: work out from given facts, figures or information
command_words.Consider: review and respond to given information
command_words.Demonstrate: show how or give an example
command_words.Describe: state the points of a topic / give characteristics and main features
command_words.Determine: establish an answer using the information available
command_words.Discuss: write about issue(s) or topic(s) in depth in a structured way
command_words.Evaluate: judge or calculate the quality, importance, amount, or value of something
command_words.Explain: set out purposes or reasons / make the relationships between things evident / provide why and/or how and support with relevant evidence
command_words.Give: produce an answer from a given source or recall/memory
command_words.Predict: suggest what may happen based on available information
command_words.Show (that): provide structured evidence that leads to a given result
command_words.Sketch: make a simple drawing showing the key features
command_words.Suggest: apply knowledge and understanding to situations where there are a range of valid responses in order to make proposals / put forward considerations
